# What NAS Protocols does Cohesity support for ONTAP
Source: https://kb.netapp.com/on-prem/ontap/da/NAS/NAS-KBs/What_NAS_Protocols_does_Cohesity_support_for_ONTAP
Fetched: 2026-07-07

## Applies to

- ONTAP 9
- CIFS
- NFS
- S3
- Cohesity

## Answer

- Cohesity officially supports NFS and CIFS for ONTAP
- S3 standalone buckets have not been fully qualified by Cohesity for use with ONTAP
- StorageGrid is also officially supported by Cohesity

## Additional Information

- Cohesity certified platforms (https://www.cohesity.com/products/certified-platforms/)
- TR-4814 S3 in ONTAP best practices (https://www.netapp.com/media/17219-tr4814.pdf)
